fields.value: ROBITA is a humanoid robot with two compact color CCD cameras on its head, two degrees of freedom for each camera, two neck degrees of freedom, two microphones, one waist degree of freedom, and wheels.

quotes.text: The robot has two compact color CCD cameras on its head and 2 DOF for each of the camera.
The head has 2 DOF on the bottom of it (namely neck part). Two microphones are mounted on the both sides of the head.
Under the body it has 1 DOF for waist, and wheels to move around.

fields.value: The paper presents ROBITA, a humanoid group-conversation system for baseball discussion that can observe, take turns, answer questions, and correct incorrect game results. It uses recognized human gaze to help select the next speaker and uses its camera/eye direction to display attention and indicate turn allocation; no measured user effects are reported.

RQ1; RQ2; RQ4; RQ5 — The paper describes gaze direction as a cue for selecting the next speaker and details its interaction role and implementation. It also describes the ROBITA embodiment, but does not report measured effects or how embodiment influences the study.
